title: Oklahoma Shuts Out Baylor 35-0 on November 20, 2004
question: What happened when Oklahoma played Baylor in Waco on November 20, 2004?
answer: On November 20, 2004, No. 2 Oklahoma beat Baylor 35-0 at Floyd Casey Stadium in Waco. Freshman Adrian Peterson ran 32 times for 240 yards and three touchdowns.
summary: On this date in 2004, No. 2 Oklahoma blanked Baylor 35-0 in Waco as freshman Adrian Peterson rushed for 240 yards and three scores.
body: Today is a good day to look back at a Saturday in Waco. On November 20, 2004, the second-ranked Sooners traveled to Floyd Casey Stadium to face Baylor and came home with a 35-0 shutout.

Oklahoma arrived at 11-0 overall and 8-0 in the Big 12, while Baylor stood at 3-8 and 1-7 in conference play. The Sooners scored in every quarter, with the box score showing 7 points in the first, 7 in the second, 14 in the third and 7 in the fourth. Baylor never put a point on the board.

The star was freshman running back Adrian Peterson, who carried 32 times for 240 net yards and three touchdowns. Quarterback Jason White completed 19 of 32 passes for 194 yards and two touchdowns without an interception. Oklahoma finished with 501 total yards on 81 plays, compared with 156 yards on 53 plays for the Bears.

The win was the last regular-season road game of an unbeaten year. Oklahoma went on to play Colorado in the Big 12 Championship Game on December 4, winning 42-3, before meeting USC in the national championship game.
